correctness.rationale: For a planar SPD eigenbasis orbit A_theta=R_theta diag(1,epsilon)R_theta^T, a single fixed projective-isotropic probe has relative squared Frobenius error E_theta=[cos^2(phi-theta)+epsilon^2 sin^2(phi-theta)]^-1. For 1<=x<epsilon^-2, the set of phi passing all theta on the arc has projective length (2 arccos(sqrt((1/x-eps^2)/(1-eps^2)))-Theta)_+; hence exact CDF (q_epsilon(x)-Theta/pi)_+, atom min(Theta/pi,1) at the worst value. Integration over projective angles gives E Z_Theta=Theta/(pi epsilon^2)+2/(pi epsilon) arctan(tan((pi-Theta)/2)/epsilon) when Theta<=pi and epsilon^-2 beyond. Independent preassigned probes on K blocks multiply independent probabilities; AM-GM gives equal-part optimum (q-t/K)_+^K. Strict negativity of f"(k) and Lambert-W root establish unique continuous optimizer and integer neighbors, with the t->infinity law. Independent angular quadrature, mean integral and optimization checks corroborated and treat Theta=0,pi boundaries.
